AI 补全空白翻译: Fill in missing translations with AI
会删除它的代码文件、菜单与权限、数据表（包括其中的数据）和迁移记录，不能恢复。: Its code files, menus and permissions, table (with its data) and migration record will be deleted. This can't be undone.
后端正在重启以加载新代码，稍后自动继续…: The backend is restarting to load the new code; this continues automatically…
在线建模只在开发环境可用: The visual modeler is only available in development
填写标题和字段标签后在这里翻译: Fill in the title and field labels, then translate them here
如：做一个设备台账，记录名称、编号、状态、采购日期和价格: e.g. A device register with name, number, status, purchase date and price
它会把代码写进仓库并执行数据库迁移，所以只在本地开发（pnpm dev）时开放，: It writes code into the repository and runs database migrations, so it is only open in local development (pnpm dev), and only to super admins.
已生成字段清单，请检查后再生成模块: Fields drafted. Review them before generating the module.
撤销会删除模块的代码、菜单、数据表和数据，只用于试错；已经在用的模块请手动维护: Undoing deletes the code, menus, table and data of a module; it is meant for trying things out. Maintain modules in use by hand.
状态、级别等几个固定值: A few fixed values such as status or level
生成会依次执行：生成代码 → 迁移数据库 → 同步菜单权限 → 更新接口文档 →: Generating runs: generate code → migrate the database → sync menus and permissions → update the API docs → the verify gate. If any step fails, everything from this run is undone. The code lands in the repository, where you can keep editing it and commit it.
用一句话描述要做的功能，AI 按字段类型规则生成字段清单，再在下面修改: Describe the feature in a sentence; AI drafts the fields following the field type rules, and you adjust them below
编号 / 编码类通常必填且唯一；ID、创建时间、更新时间自动添加: Numbers and codes are usually required and unique; ID, created and updated times are added automatically
英文 snake_case，决定表名、接口地址和权限码: English snake_case; sets the table name, API path and permission codes
记录归属部门和创建人，按角色的数据范围过滤: Rows belong to a department and creator and are filtered by the role's data scope
还没有数据字典，先到「数据字典」添加: No dictionaries yet. Add one under Data dictionary first.
还没有用建模器生成的模块: No modules generated with the modeler yet
页面文字与菜单名的英文、日文；留空时使用字段名: English and Japanese for the page and menu names; empty ones use the field name
